factual_claims.source_evidence: COMPANY PROFILE states: 'On 30.07.2025, Nordic Fibreboard AS and Pärnu Riverside Development OÜ entered into a merger agreement... the balance sheet date of the merger is 01.06.2025... As a result of the merger, the owner and manager of the Suur-Jõe 48 property is Nordic Fibreboard AS.'

factual_claims.claim: After the balance sheet date on 8 January 2026, the company entered a preliminary sale-purchase agreement for ten properties in the Admirali quarter, with final execution scheduled by 30 June 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: NOTE 26 EVENTS AFTER BALANCE SHEET DATE states: 'After the balance sheet date, on 08.01.2026 Nordic Fibreboard AS entered into a preliminary salepurchase agreement for the sale of ten properties... The final sale-purchase agreement... will be concluded... no later than 30.06.2026.'
